724:t_2:24.en:
$$赤木$$
「It's no good...! People like us... can't protect the city... can't protect the peace!」

724:t_2:25.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「My memory... is slipping away...」

724:t_2:27.en:
$$宗介$$
「Don't go, $$千鳥$$...! You're not $$ソフィア$$, you're $$千鳥かなめ$$!」

724:t_2:31.en:
$$シンジ$$
「$$綾波$$...! I... wanted to save you!!」

724:t_3:4.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「...So with this dimensional barrier system, we can contain $$アサキム$$. Is that right?」

724:t_3:5.en:
$$テッサ$$
「It draws out $$次元力$$ like $$ＺＯＮＥ$$, then diverts it into another dimension... With this, surely...」

724:t_3:6.en:
$$トライア$$
「Honestly, I'm not confident. But this is the best we can do right now.」

724:t_3:7.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Hearing you say that is enough. All that's left is to try it.」

724:t_3:8.en:
$$ブライト$$
「The time left to us is limited. We have to hurry as much as we possibly can.」

724:t_3:9.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「$$アサキム・ドーウィン$$ and the $$御使い$$s... Beings who wield the power of immortality...」

724:t_3:10.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Will our coming showdown with $$アサキム$$ be a touchstone for the battle against the $$御使い$$s...?」

724:t_3:12.en:
$$ブライト$$
「It means we have to win.」

724:t_3:13.en:
$$トライア$$
「We'll finish the final adjustments on our end, so please handle the operation to pin down $$アサキム$$'s movements, everyone.」

724:t_3:15.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Then, Doctor... In 12 hours, $c will descend to $$エス・テラン$$.」

724:t_3:16.en:
$$トライア$$
「...We've done everything we can... All that's left is to trust to luck, I guess.」

724:t_3:17.en:
$$トライア$$
(But as for the other problem, I'm completely out of ideas...)

724:t_3:18.en:
$$トライア$$
(The distortion in the dimensional boundaries across the whole universe is spreading at an accelerating rate... What on earth is causing it...?)

724:t_3:19.en:
$$トライア$$
(What is the universe seeking...? How do the $$御使い$$s intend to stop it...?)

724:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I can imagine how you feel, Prince $$グーラ$$.」

724:t_10:5.en:
$$グーラ$$
「In the final moment, Father, who had become the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$, returned to the Father in my memories...」

724:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Had that been possible sooner, the outcome might well have been different.」

724:t_10:7.en:
$$グーラ$$
「It's all right... If he hadn't been defeated, Father surely would never have acknowledged the power of hope.」

724:t_10:8.en:
$$グーラ$$
「I will live on... proud that in the end I made Father regain his old heart.」

724:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your strong resolve, Prince $$グーラ$$, produced $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 100 Z. I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

724:t_10:10.en:
$$グーラ$$
「So this is the $$Ｚチップ$$ born from Father and me fighting... It's beautiful.」

724:t_10:12.en:
$$グーラ$$
「To be worthy of this radiance, I will live strong. Because that is the last hope Father left behind for me.」

724:t_10:13.en:
$$グーラ$$
(Farewell, Father... I will... go on living with hope in my heart, together with $$正太郎$$ and the others...)

724:t_10:20.en:
$$メール$$
「He's been deep in thought this whole time. I bet it's about $$アサキム$$.」

724:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Is he thinking about how to teach that guy a lesson?」

724:t_10:22.en:
$$メール$$
「No. I think Darling wants to talk with $$アサキム$$.」

724:t_10:24.en:
$$メール$$
「Sure, I think what $$アサキム$$ did to $$セツコ$$ is unforgivable.」

724:t_10:25.en:
$$メール$$
「But Darling... he just can't bring himself to hate that guy, it seems.」

724:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Hmm... Indeed, there were times during the $$多元戦争$$ when $$ランド$$ connected with $$アサキム$$ heart to heart...」

724:t_10:27.en:
$$メール$$
「That's why I think Darling doesn't want to fight $$アサキム$$.」

724:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$アサキム$$ has his own way of living... I will simply let events take their course.」

724:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then today, let's run the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ quietly so we don't disturb $$ランド$$.」

724:t_10:33.en:
$$メール$$
(Darling... Whatever answer you come to, I'll stick with you...)

725:t_000:0.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Successful hyperspace transit confirmed.」

725:t_001:0.en:
$$リーロン$$
「No doubt about it. The third planet of the solar system in the Milky Way of $$カオス・コスモス$$...」

725:t_001:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「This universe's Earth... So that's $$エス・テラン$$.」

725:t_001:2.en:
$$トライア$$
「Incidentally, they call it a solar system, but there doesn't seem to be a sun like the one in our world.」

725:t_001:3.en:
$$エスター$$
「Then the light around here is coming from $$エス・テラン$$, isn't it?」

725:t_001:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And the dimensional barrier around it, on top of that... It's brimming with the kind of vanity that practically announces 'We are special beings.'」

725:t_001:5.en:
$$リーロン$$
「This is no time for that. Looks like we're getting a welcoming party right away.」

725:t_001:6.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「A fight is very likely! We launch too!」

725:t_002:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「$$アサキム$$ or the $$御使い$$s, I don't care. Whichever it is, we just fight.」

725:t_003:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$ハーデス$$! And $$ズール$$ and the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ too!」

725:t_003:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「You finally showed up, bosses of the evil god alliance!」

725:t_003:2.en:
$$ズール$$
「I'm surprised, Earthlings. To think you actually survived.」

725:t_003:3.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「And that you made it to this planet... is nothing short of a miracle.」

725:t_003:4.en:
$$赤木$$
「Sorry to disappoint you. This is down to our own ability.」

725:t_003:5.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Because miracles are something you make happen with your own power.」

725:t_003:6.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Hmph... How arrogant of you.」

725:t_003:7.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Are you after the $$御使い$$s on that planet too!?」

725:t_003:8.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Exactly. That will be the battle of the gods... the end of the True War.」

725:t_003:9.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「We crossed the $$天柱$$, defeated the many gods who had invaded this universe, and came here.」

725:t_003:10.en:
$$ズール$$
「To defeat the $$御使い$$s and take all of this universe for ourselves.」

725:t_003:11.en:
$$勝平$$
「For you lot, you did well not to turn on each other!」
